messages:
Sam: CI alert: image publish failing on PR #6789. Build step 'push-image' errors with 'unexpected EOF while reading chunked body' and `manifest PUT 5xx` intermittently. Dockerfile changed base from ubuntu:20.04 -> 22.04 and added multi-stage. Anyone seen this after Dockerfile reorg?

Olga: cc @Kevin @Jin — did we change build cache or kaniko version in the CI image?

Kevin: I didn't touch kaniko. CI moved kaniko->v1.9 in last deploy. Can you paste the push log?

Sam: here's the tail of the push log:
```
Pushing to registry...
PUT /v2/redwood/app/manifests/latest 500
upload 789012/1234567 unexpected EOF
Retrying...
error: failed to upload layer: unexpected EOF
```

CI-Bot: Build 2871 failed: https://ci.redwood/2871 -> logs attached.

Olga: Two quick things: 1) try `docker build --no-cache -t tmp:local .` and `docker push` locally to reproduce; 2) check registry multipart uploads / proxy timeouts. @Marta can you check registry/nginx health?

Jin: I'll bisect the commits touching Dockerfile/ci in the last 48h. @Sam, can you try running kaniko with debug (`--verbosity debug` / `--v=9`)? We had a 'truncated tar' flake once when a COPY produced a symlink loop.

Marta: Registry nodes look healthy overall, no disk pressure, but nginx on node-3 showed a bunch of 502/504s in last 30m. I restarted nginx on node-3 and cleared incomplete multipart uploads in the registry.

Kevin: If nginx was dropping chunked bodies we'd see EOFs. Rerun CI after the restart?

Sam: Rerunning CI now -> triggered rebuild: https://ci.redwood/2871/rebuild (manual rerun).

CI-Bot: Rebuild started: 2871.2.

Sam: Update: rebuild finished, push succeeded. Logs show `PUT /v2/.../manifests/latest 201` and no EOFs. Artifact size looks unchanged.

Olga: Great. Follow-ups: add retry/backoff to the push step and increase nginx `proxy_read_timeout` for registry upstreams. Filing INF-1243.

Jin: I'll continue the bisect to double-check there's no latent change, but good to close this incident for now.

Marta: Noted. Added a line to infra notes about node-3 nginx restart and monitoring rule for chunked upload errors.

Sam: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
